text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 243 单元

captain
音标：英 /'kæptɪn/  美 /ˈkæptən/
n. 首领, 船长
短语：sea captain — 船长
短语：captain cook — 库克船长（英国探险家和航海家）
短语：captain of industry — 大企业之首脑
例句：The captain and crew welcome you aboard.
机长和全体机组人员欢迎各位乘坐本次航班。

extension
音标：英 /ɪk'stenʃ(ə)n; ek-/  美 /ɪk'stɛnʃən/

暴风雪增加了我们的困难。

ethological
n. 行为性的,  行为学的
例句：At Agile 2006, she examined the cooperative behavior of Bonobo apes from an ethological perspective and spoke about how “natural” the cooperative aspects of Agile are.

例句：At Agile 2006, she examined the cooperative behavior of Bonobo apes from an ethological perspective and spoke about how "natural" the cooperative aspects of Agile are.
